column1: # The holds of the public boundary lint (//:public_boundary, tools/build/lint/defs.bzl,
# public_boundary; what each rule matches: tools/build/lint/public_boundary.awk): the
# findings a file must keep. One row per rule and file, tab-separated:
# <rule> <file> <count> <reason>. The file must have exactly <count> findings of the
# rule: one more fails the build naming it; one fewer fails too, asking for the count
# to be lowered or the row deleted. So this file only shrinks. The rule `deny` (a
# private consumer's words) cannot be held.
